'''2006 World Championship Day 2 Brian Hunter DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter (2006-10-25).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35761 White Slavery done RIGHT]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071014025541/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35761 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2006 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
